text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! I got completely crushed in that
race!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess should never lose in such an
unsightly
manner!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I thought I could do better!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: 君はすごく頑張ったよ
貴方はすごく頑張ったよ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, but you worked even harder than I
did,
Trainer...
choice_data_list: 君はすごく頑張ったよ
貴方はすごく頑張ったよ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really wanted to meet your

expectations. But with how things ended
today...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No... I just have to work harder to
achieve my
goals. I'll regain my honor in
the next race!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time for a full mental
refresh—princess
style!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! I'll be sure to claim first
place next
time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: 姫たるもの、わめかず反省！
choice_data_list_en: A true princess reflects calmly instead of throwing a fit!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It's not like me to lose
heart!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This calls for some waterfall training! The
surging
water will wash away the
weakness in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ In past Princess Fighter series,
there's
always that episode where the
princess clears her
doubts by training
under a waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we immediately head out and
search
for a waterfall for Kawakami
Princess to train
under.
